description: Module integration and intelligent context sharing: Make journal, analysis, chat, dashboard, goals, and skills all aware of each other and feed data between them. Add cross-module context so the AI truly understands the user over time.
steps: In analyzer.py - _build_chat_context: Enhance journal context injection. Currently sends last 10 entries. Add: recent analysis insights summary (last AI analysis result, trimmed to 200 chars), active goals with progress, recent mood check-in scores, recent skill exercises completed (from entries tagged skill_exercise). This makes the AI chat aware of everything the user has done.

In analyzer.py - ai_analysis: Add goals context and recent chat themes to the analysis prompt. Pull active goals from the caller and include them so the analysis can comment on goal progress. Add a section asking the AI to connect journal patterns to stated goals.

In app.py - page_chat: After each AI response, check if the response mentions a pattern or suggestion that could become a goal. Add a small 'Turn this into a goal?' button below AI responses that contain action items (detect by looking for phrases like 'try', 'consider', 'experiment with', 'practice').

In app.py - page_dashboard: Add a 'Recent Insights' card at the top that pulls the most recent AI analysis and shows 2-3 key takeaways (first 3 bullet points or bold sections from the analysis result). Link to full analysis.

In app.py - page_journal: After saving an entry, if the user has active goals, show a brief note connecting the entry to relevant goals. Example: if they wrote about exercise and have a health goal, show 'This connects to your goal: [goal title]'. Use simple keyword matching between entry topics and goal titles.

In app.py - page_skills: Make skill recommendations context-aware. If recent entries show high anxiety (check recent sentiment + emotion detection), surface the 'distress_tolerance' and 'mindfulness' modules at the top. If entries show self-criticism, surface 'self_compassion'. Add a 'Recommended for you' section above the category selector.

In database.py: Add a get_latest_analysis(user_id, analysis_type) function that returns just the most recent analysis of a given type. Add get_recent_entries_text(user_id, limit=5) that returns concatenated recent entry content for quick context building.
In analyzer.py - ai_reflection_prompts: Fix the bug where goals_context uses g.get('goal_text') but the actual field in the database/dict is 'title'. Change to g.get('title', '').
acceptance_criteria: AI chat is aware of active goals, recent analyses, mood check-ins, and completed skills
AI analysis references and connects to active goals
Skills page recommends modules based on recent emotional patterns
Journal saves show connections to active goals when relevant
The goals bug in ai_reflection_prompts is fixed (uses 'title' not 'goal_text')
verification: Run python -m py_compile app.py && python -m py_compile analyzer.py && python -m py_compile database.py
Run python -c "from database import init_db, get_latest_analysis, get_recent_entries_text; init_db(); print('New DB functions available')"
Run python -c "import app; print('Full app imports cleanly')"
findings: All changes compile and import cleanly. The ScriptRunContext warnings during bare import are expected (documented in FEAT-001). All acceptance criteria met: ai_chat receives goals, ai_analysis includes goals context, skills recommend based on recent emotions, journal shows goal connections, dashboard shows recent insights, and the goal_text bug in ai_reflection_prompts is fixed.
